info.title: MoneyToHome — API vận hành AI
info.description: Reads MoneyToHome and records EarnApp balances, payout preparation, sent / unknown results and money received on PayPal. It does NOT connect to any VM, does not log in to EarnApp and does not send money. Every answer is the envelope {ok, data, error} with X-Request-Id. Writes need X-Ops-Pin and Idempotency-Key; a write answer is {replay, recorded, current}: `recorded` = this command as first written (identical on a replay), `current` = the state now. Effective rights = the user's current rights ∩ the token's projects ∩ the token's operations.

details.description: Filtered by rights. On 409: `current` = the state now (VM: expectedCycle, revision, earnAppAccountId; or the withdrawal). DUPLICATE: withdrawalId / receiptId.
